text:
maya: Noticed inconsistency in the API reference for PATCH /models/{model_id}/settings — OpenAPI schema shows `safety: { blocklist: [...] }` but the example payload in the page uses `safety_blocklist` at top-level. PR that brought the old example: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

jonathan: Good catch. Which should the docs reflect? live API or legacy example?

lee: Live runtime uses nested safety object (we migrated runtime in Q3). We still accept flat keys via a short-lived compatibility shim, but docs need to show the current contract (nested).

sam: Plan: (1) Update example JSON in the API reference to use `safety: { blocklist: [...] }`. (2) Replace SDK snippets in docs (Go and JS) that showed SafetyBlocklist/safety_blocklist to the nested form. (3) Add a short migration note with a jq/curl transform and deprecation window.

maya: I'll update the example JSON and add the migration blurb. Will run the docs linter locally before sending the PR — CI already flagged the mismatch.

doc-builder-bot: build failed: docs/api/models.yaml: schema-example-mismatch (error 1004). See CI details: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/1234

jonathan: Current Go snippet in docs reads:
```go
req := &UpdateModelSettings{
  SafetyBlocklist: []string{"bad", "worse"},
}
client.UpdateModel(ctx, modelID, req)
```
should be:
```go
req := &UpdateModelSettings{
  Safety: &SafetySettings{
    Blocklist: []string{"bad", "worse"},
  },
}
client.UpdateModel(ctx, modelID, req)
```
I'll open a small follow-up PR to patch snippets.

lee: JS snippet swap `safety_blocklist` -> `safety: { blocklist: [...] }`. Also audit curl examples and openapi/examples/models/update-settings.json.

sam: Suggested migration blurb: "Deprecated top-level keys (e.g., `safety_blocklist`). As of 2024-09-01, clients should send `safety: { blocklist: [...] }`. A compatibility shim will accept old keys for ~30 days; migrate promptly." Include example transform:
```bash
# old: {"safety_blocklist": ["x"]}
cat old.json | jq '{safety: {blocklist: .safety_blocklist}}' | curl -X PATCH -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @- https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/$ID/settings
```

maya: PR owners: maya (example + migration note), jonathan (docs snippets), lee (confirm shim removal timeline), sam (changelog). I'll queue docs-review on the PRs and link this thread.

jonathan: Thanks — please ping when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
